questions.text: Outline any concerns regarding the impact of the Acquisition on competition, including if Nielsen and DoubleVerify are close competitors in the supply of any product or solution and there are not many alternatives.
Provide a brief description of your business or organisation, including any commercial relationships with Nielsen and/or DoubleVerify.

questions.section: Questions for customers of media and audience measurement services and/or digital advertising verification and media quality services
questions.text: Provide a brief description of the media and audience measurement services or digital advertising verification and media quality services that you currently use and which providers they are from.

questions.section: Questions for customers of media and audience measurement services and/or digital advertising verification and media quality services
questions.text: What features are important to your organisation in a media audience measurement service provider and/or a digital advertising verification and media quality services provider? Does your organisation consider either Nielsen’s or DoubleVerify’s products or services to be ‘must-have’ products or services?

questions.section: Questions for customers of media and audience measurement services and/or digital advertising verification and media quality services
questions.text: Who are the other suppliers of media audience measurement services or digital advertising verification and media quality services available to Australian customers? How do they compare to DoubleVerify and/or Nielsen?

questions.section: Questions for customers of media and audience measurement services and/or digital advertising verification and media quality services
questions.text: If your organisation procures both media and audience measurement services and digital advertising verification and media quality services, are they procured independently or as part of a bundle with other products?
Provide any additional information or comments that you consider relevant to the ACCC’s assessment of the Acquisition.
